fields.title: Flex, creases and defects
fields.finding: Flat coupon values do not include deployment folds, abrasion, crease pinholes or square-kilometre-equivalent defect statistics.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure leak and WVTR after representative forming, flex, handling, UV and abrasion; include seams and penetrations.

claim: Flat coupon values do not include deployment folds, abrasion, crease pinholes or square-kilometre-equivalent defect statistics. | Flex, creases and defects
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
